correct_sign_rule: LONG pays when funding>0 (Hyperliquid: positive funding = long pays short)
correct_frequency_rule: hourly settlements using actual Hyperliquid funding observations
quoted_convention: If the contract's price is higher than the oracle price, the premium and hence the funding rate will be positive, and the long position will pay
implementation_rule: funding_pnl = -funding_rate * notional (for LONG); funding_pnl = +funding_rate * notional (for SHORT)

funding_pnl_formula.long: funding_pnl = sum(-rate_i * 1h * notional) for each hourly observation crossed
funding_pnl_formula.short: funding_pnl = sum(+rate_i * 1h * notional) for each hourly observation crossed
